component.name: MultiFlexi NetBox
component.summary: NetBox REST API credential prototype for MultiFlexi

description.p: Provides the NetBox credential prototype for MultiFlexi core, defining the NETBOX_URL and NETBOX_TOKEN configuration fields required to talk to a NetBox IPAM / DCIM instance.
Also ships a web UI component that probes /api/status/ with the configured token and displays NetBox version and plugin information.
